cohort: 111 obese pregnant women who delivered at Dr. Cipto Mangunkusumo National General Hospital (RSCM) from 2014 to 2019
finding: There were no significant differences in maternal and perinatal outcomes prevalence between different obesity grades.
mod_finding: Obese patients in this study had a higher rate of cesarean delivery (86.5%).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight tended to increase with increasing BMI group
